# VOGLER CONSULTING

> Swiss consulting firm for AI, agentic AI, analytics, and data. We deliver custom end-to-end applications and pipelines, advise on agentic-AI architecture, run use-case discovery and enterprise RAG deployments, and offer hands-on workshops for organisations in DACH.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://vogler-consulting.ch/services): Workshops and bespoke end-to-end delivery.
- [Data workshop](https://vogler-consulting.ch/services): Data management, modelling, processing.
- [Code workshop](https://vogler-consulting.ch/services): Modern Python stack, CI/CD, testing, software architecture.
- [Cloud workshop](https://vogler-consulting.ch/services): Cloud concepts, orchestration, observability, security, dashboards.
- [Agentic AI workshop](https://vogler-consulting.ch/services): Concepts, system and cognitive architecture, frameworks, reliability, governance.
- [End-to-end delivery](https://vogler-consulting.ch/services): Cloud-based data-science pipelines, production-ready.
